correctness.rationale: For the Cartesian P3 square P4 grid, independently listed 17 edges, 11 perfect-match facets and 495 faces with dimension counts (17,85,164,151,66,11). Independently generated a valid greedy sequence of 242 elementary free-face collapses leaving exactly 5 vertices and 5 edges on one cycle, proving homotopy S1 integrally; this confirms the package 242-pair certificate without relying on its log. Computed all oriented fixed-simplex Lefschetz traces on the original complex: L(row)=2, L(column)=0, L(both)=2; since H0=Z and H1=Z, the actions are (-1,+1,-1). Transfer after barycentric subdivision proves the rational homology of reflection quotients. No global 3xn theorem is claimed.

originality.rationale: Chandrakar–Singh 2025 treats perfect-matching complexes of polygonal line tilings and specifically P2 square Pn grids, with general rectangular-grid conjecture rather than an inspected P3 square P4 result. Resultary matching-complex 3xn records concern the ordinary matching complex or different cut complexes, not facets consisting of perfect matchings. The new finite exact collapse and integral reflection signs are not covered by those statements.
